title: From Banda Singh’s Reported Death to the Sakhi of His Disappearance

blocks.text: Even after the execution account, the text acknowledges that many people said we did not believe he had died. The page names companions such as Baaj Singh, Aali Singh and Maali Singh, tying Banda's fate to the wider company that suffered with him.

From there the narrative pivots into the sakhi of Banda's disappearance, showing that memory refused to settle into a single final report. Instead of leaving only an obituary, the tradition preserves a second stream in which Banda did not simply perish in the ordinary way remembered by courts.

This makes the page an explicit transition from historical execution to legendary afterlife. The death report remains, but it is immediately shadowed by stories that Banda escaped, vanished, or endured in another form.
